biotools.summary: NBC++ is an incremental Naive Bayes classifier designed for metagenomic taxonomic classification. It focuses on query performance and memory efficiency, utilizing canonical k-mer storage and adaptable memory allocation, and is available through GitHub with a Dockerfile for easy deployment.
